title: Localized Hom germ comparison for a complex on the base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(S_{et}))$, $L$ a K-injective cochain complex of abelian etale sheaves on $S$, $r:K\cong QL$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, and $i$ a representative affine pointed neighbourhood. Use the free sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs] and the canonical small-model source germ leg of [def-weil-pbc-small-model-cohomology-germs]. Define $E_i$ from $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf Z[V_i][0],K[n])$ to $H^n(L(V_i))$ by the bounded-below inclusion, transport by $r$, the K-injective localization bijection, Hom-complex homology, and degreewise free-generator evaluation, exactly as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison], stopping before any stage pullback. Define $b_i:H^n(L(V_i))\to\Gamma(S_{(s)},H^n(g^{-1}K))$ by applying the neighbourhood section restriction of [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] degreewise to $L$, taking homology, using the exact-inverse-image localization comparison, transporting by $g^{-1}r^{-1}$, and commuting exact strict-local sections with homology. These constructions do not choose a representative of a class. Then the canonical source germ leg equals $E_i b_i$. No morphism $f$, base-change mate or fibre cohomology is involved.

proof.text: In the adopted source implementation, re-exported by the restored Sheaf module: Move the canonical derived-sections comparison across the presheaf germ by toPresheafFiber_naturality. Use the characterizing equation of the chosen unique stalk restriction to express the source leg as the germ-comparison component, the neighbourhood section restriction, and the exact-inverse-image homology comparison. This is the proved private helper sourceLeg_eq_sectionRestriction.

In the adopted source implementation, re-exported by the restored Sheaf module: Use surjectivity of the inverse composite of sourcePlusHomIso and sourceClassDerivedHomIso to represent an arbitrary derived Hom element by a CohomologyClass. Use mk_surjective and Cocycle.fromSingleMk_surjective to represent it by an actual single-source cycle f. Cancellation of the Hom isomorphisms proves heval, expressing sourceLocalizedSectionsIso on this element as the evaluated Hom-complex homology class.

In the adopted source implementation, re-exported by the restored Sheaf module: Apply sourceLocalizedCocycleHomology to identify the germ-comparison component with the homology section of f. Apply sourceCocycleExactRestriction with the proved natural transformation strictLocalSectionRestrictionNat. Its two sides are precisely the section-restriction side and strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction of the evaluated Hom-complex class. Symmetry gives the required equality for every derived Hom element, and extensionality gives the morphism equality.

Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.

lean.statement: theorem smallModel_sourceLocalizedSectionsIso_germ {S : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})) (L : CochainComplex (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) [L.IsKInjective] (r : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (n : ℤ) (i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)) : (smallModel_strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs s K n).app (op i) = (sourceLocalizedSectionsIso K L r n ((strictLocalNeighbourhoods s).obj i)).hom ≫ strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction s K L r n i
